phrase: a Period Pain Relief Device Brand
verdict: Yes. Matri from Kolkata pitched period pain relieving devices on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Many women deal with period pain every month, and a drug-free device appeals to them, but claims need evidence and devices may need CDSCO registration.
angle: Heat and TENS-based devices relieve period cramps without medicines. They sell online and through gynaecologists. Evidence, safety and comfort decide reviews, and women's health creators are a strong channel.
